title: Leave Application Template
description: Free leave application format for office or school with To/From, date, subject, leave dates, reason and contact during leave, on one A4 page. Use it in Word, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Excel or Overleaf.
features: Ready To/From, date and subject lines
Leave dates, number of days and reason in one table
Contact details during leave and signature block
useCases: Casual or sick leave from office

blocks.text: Subject: **Application for [casual / sick / earned] leave from [DD/MM/YYYY] to [DD/MM/YYYY]**

text: I request leave for **[3] days** from **[DD/MM/YYYY]** to **[DD/MM/YYYY]** because [state the reason briefly, e.g. a family function in my hometown].
I have completed my pending work and **[colleague name]** has agreed to handle urgent tasks during my absence. I will rejoin on **[DD/MM/YYYY]**.
Kindly grant me leave for the above period.
